source: NCEP Artificial Intelligence Global Forecast System (AIGFS) v1.x, GraphCast-based, 0.25-degree deterministic GRIB2 product

front_door.authority: NWS Service Change Notice 25-89 (2025-12-09): operational data on the NCEP NOMADS server ONLY; no FTP, and MEASURED 2026-08-17: no operational AWS mirror exists (noaa-aigfs-pds and siblings 404, noaa-gfs-bdp-pds has no aigfs prefix), no NOMADS GRIB filter CGI (filter_aigfs.pl 404), and NOMADS keeps a 10-day rolling window with no archive behind it
front_door.cadence: cycles 00/06/12/18 UTC, steps f000..f384 every 6 hours, exactly two files per step (pres, sfc)

identity.local_tables_version: 1, stamped on every message but unused: every discipline.category.parameterNumber triple resolves against stock WMO tables (MEASURED, exhaustive scan)
identity.ai_flagging: NONE -- typeOfProcessedData=fc and typeOfGeneratingProcess=2 exactly like the physical GFS; generatingProcessIdentifier 137 and this front door are the only identity facts

imposter.name: EAGLE experimental line, bucket noaa-nws-graphcastgfs-pds
imposter.trap: the S3 bucket serves DIFFERENT bytes under IDENTICAL object names and directory layout: a different run with a different field set (65-message pres without vertical velocity at f000 versus the operational 78; a 12-message sfc adding fields the operational product does not publish), differing by up to 8.66 gpm in 500 hPa geopotential height, 9.51 m s-1 in 250 hPa wind and 198.6 Pa in mean-sea-level pressure (MEASURED, 2026-08-17 00Z)
imposter.in_band_discriminator: subCentre: 0 operational, 2 in the EAGLE copy; nothing in the filename distinguishes them
imposter.refusal: every selector in the mapping pins subcenter=0, so EAGLE bytes match zero selectors and the decode refuses by naming the pinned-versus-observed identity octets instead of silently mixing model versions; note the EAGLE sfc files carry two subCentre-0 messages among their extras, which cannot complete a frame either -- the 3-D state still refuses and frame materialization refuses missing required fields

deliberate_exclusions.total_precipitation: published as PDT-8 accumulations in two windows that share paramId/level/step from f012 onward and are byte-identical duplicates at f006; interval statistics are not bindable initialization state, so no selector matches them and the duplicate/window trap cannot fire
deliberate_exclusions.acpcp: EAGLE copy only: bitsPerValue=0 constant NEGATIVE field, a packing artifact of a field GraphCast never produced; never selected
deliberate_exclusions.idx_sidecars: the wgrib2 .idx renders the long-range accumulation window as '0-16 day' while the GRIB itself carries hours; the profile trusts the message bytes and never reads the sidecar

grid_note: regular_ll 1440x721 at 0.25 degrees, GDT 0, north-to-south rows, longitude origin 0 running to 359.75 -- the MIRROR of the AIFS 0.25-degree twin whose longitudes start at 180: an array copied between the two conventions without the coordinate metadata is rolled by half the domain
member_policy: deterministic from the bytes: PDT 0/8 only, no ensemble keys anywhere; the ensemble sibling is a separate product line
time_policy: instantaneous PDT-0 state at every published step; the f000 sfc file has no accumulation messages, and the operational pres file carries real (non-zero-filled) vertical velocity at f000
input_identity: dynamic file paths and SHA-256 values are owned by the mapped-source input manifest, gpuwm-mapped-source-inputs-v1; this profile has no composition inputs until the cross-source land-surface donor lands
